title: Optimize: recommendation digest, safe-apply preview, and change ledger
creator: Miles Chen
description: Build a cohesive Console workflow that surfaces batching and caching recommendations as compact recommendation digests, renders a safe 'config diff' preview for proposed changes, and records a tamper-evident change ledger and apply history for auditing and rollback. This ticket covers PM requirements, acceptance criteria, and coordinating handoffs with Design and Engineering for an initial canary release to select accounts.
acceptance_criteria: Recommendation digest cards available on the Optimize -> Recommendations page with succinct rationale, estimated cost delta, estimated latency impact, and confidence score
Clicking a recommendation opens a side panel showing a human-readable config diff and machine diff (JSON) with highlighted token-level or batching parameters changed
Support a staged apply flow: Preview -> Confirm -> Apply; applying creates an immutable audit record with before/after config, who applied it, timestamp, and a one-click rollback action
Diff preview includes automated risk flags (stateful KV cache changes, model-variant swaps, quantization profile changes) and links to runbooks when relevant
Activity feed shows per-recommendation apply history and links to infra rollout job and GitHub PR when applicable
All actions that modify runtime config go through RBAC checks and are logged to the change ledger for at least 365 days
Canary rollout option: apply to a specified percentage of traffic or a subset of routes and expose pulse metrics in the side panel during rollout
design_notes: Design to use compact card layout with badge for cost delta (e.g., -12% or +3%), small inline sparkline for recent token volume, and a confidence meter (low/medium/high)
Side panel should show split view: human-readable summary on left, JSON diff on right with editable comment box for operator notes
Diff highlighting: use color + inline callouts for risky changes (red border) and suggested guardrails (e.g., auto-rollback threshold)
Provide an affordance to preview the estimated token-level throughput after applying batching/caching recommendations
Accessibility: keyboard focus order, ARIA labels for diff region, and color contrast for confidence badges
engineering_notes: Backend: expose /optimize/recommendations/{id}/preview endpoint that returns before/after configs and a machine diff; include structured risk metadata
Config changes should be stored in immutable change records in the config-store with a schema: change_id, actor, timestamp, before_blob, after_blob, reason, rollout_spec
Rollout controller: integrate with existing Dedicated/private rollout API (ENG-2201). Support percentage-based canary using routing weights and route tags
Telemetry: emit events opt.recommendation.preview, opt.recommendation.apply, opt.recommendation.rollback with correlation_id to link to infra jobs
Guardrails: enforce RBAC via auth service; require security_review flag for changes touching KMS/HSM or network settings
Performance: diff generation must be incremental for large configs to avoid UI timeouts; implement streaming diff for JSON large blobs
rollout_plan: Week 1: finalize design mockups and API contract in PRD; security review kickoff
Week 2: implement backend preview endpoint and change ledger storage; basic UI skeleton for recommendation cards
Week 3: implement diff rendering, risk flags, and staged-apply flow; integrate RBAC checks
Week 4: internal dogfood with infra and Platform teams, run canary on non-production orgs
Week 5: pilot with 3 customer accounts, collect metrics, iterate on UX and revert flows
Week 6: GA release behind feature flag, ship docs and runbook; postmortem and metrics review
